plugins.name: wow-addon
plugins.description: World of Warcraft addon development helpers — standard-compliant scaffolding, standards compliance auditing, standards-reference refreshing (re-syncing an addon's in-repo reference and the vendored quirks catalogue as the standard evolves upstream), cross-repo learning harvesting (promoting the collection's patterns, anti-patterns, client quirks and audit findings back into the standard), pending-work triage, interface-version bumping, doc sync, version bumping, test-battery running, GitHub issue listing/creation, git diff/commit, changeset finalization (sync-docs, commit, merge, push and branch cleanup — for the current repo or across sibling repos in dependency order), CRLF hook, and a focused WoW-specific review subagent.
